exposure: bupivacaine + magnesium sulfate + normal saline TAP block
bupivacaine + dexmedetomidine + normal saline TAP block
outcome: duration of analgesia (time to first rescue dose of Tramadol)
cohort: The study involved 90 patients undergoing cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Dexmedetomidine as an adjuvant to bupivacaine in TAP block provides superior and prolonged postoperative analgesia and lower tramadol consumption compared to magnesium sulphate or bupivacaine alone, with an acceptable safety profile.
